description: BetterHitSounds is a lightweight, client-side Fabric mod that adds satisfying hit sounds when attacking entities in Minecraft. Perfect for PvP players or anyone who wants immersive audio feedback while fighting.

mods.name: BetterHitSounds
mods.description: Custom hit sounds when attacking entities.

releases.notes:
=========================================================
**BetterHitSounds – v1.1.0**
=========================================================

**Major Stability Update + Automatic Version Checker**

This update resolves the crash reported in v1.0.0 and introduces a fully automatic, production-ready update notification system.

---------------------------------------------------------
**Fixes**
---------------------------------------------------------

• Fixed NoSuchFieldError crash on Minecraft 1.21.x  
• Removed outdated compiled references  
• Rebuilt the mod in a clean environment  
• Improved overall stability and compatibility  

---------------------------------------------------------
**New Feature – Built-in Version Checker**
---------------------------------------------------------

BetterHitSounds now includes a professional update notification system.

Features:

• Asynchronous background update check  
• Proper semantic version comparison  
• Popup appears only on the Title Screen  
• Shows once per game launch  
• “Update”, “Later”, and “No Thanks” options  
• Remembers ignored versions  
• Safe external Modrinth link opening  
• Fully offline-safe (no crashes without internet)  

---------------------------------------------------------
**Why This Update Matters**
---------------------------------------------------------

You will now always be notified when a new version is available without manually checking Modrinth or GitHub.

This makes BetterHitSounds more polished, reliable, and future-ready.

---------------------------------------------------------

Thank you for the continued support ❤️  
More improvements and features coming soon.
